title: UK’s biggest EV battery gigafactory shelves expansion as Jaguar Land Rover talks stall

paragraphs.en: The UK’s biggest gigafactory has shelved plans to expand production in Sunderland because of stalled talks on a deal to supply electric car batteries to Jaguar Land Rover.
paragraphs.zh: 由于向捷豹路虎（Jaguar Land Rover）供应电动汽车电池的协议谈判陷入停滞，英国最大的电池超级工厂已搁置在桑德兰（Sunderland）扩大生产的计划。

paragraphs.en: Chinese-owned AESC produces batteries for Nissan at its gigafactory next door to the Japanese carmaker’s Sunderland plant. However, AESC has had to push back its ramp-up plans because of lower-than-expected demand from Nissan and the lack of a deal with JLR, according to people with knowledge of the situation.
paragraphs.zh: 中资控股的AESC在其毗邻日产桑德兰工厂的超级工厂为日产生产电池。然而，据知情人士透露，由于日产的需求低于预期，且与捷豹路虎未达成协议，AESC不得不推迟其增产计划。

paragraphs.en: The delays are another sign of the slowing transition from petrol and diesel to electric cars. Andy Burnham’s Labour government on Friday revealed that it could cut the UK’s electric car sales targets further , in a potential blow to the electric vehicle supply chain.
paragraphs.zh: 这些推迟是燃油车和柴油车向电动汽车过渡放缓的又一迹象。安迪·伯纳姆领导的工党政府上周五透露，它可能会进一步下调英国的电动汽车销售目标，这可能对电动汽车供应链造成打击。

paragraphs.en: Related: Andy Burnham moves to cut new EV sales targets
paragraphs.zh: 相关阅读：安迪·伯纳姆着手下调新车电动汽车销售目标

paragraphs.en: Battery manufacturers in the UK and Europe have had a difficult few years as carmakers have retreated from previous ambitious targets to switch from internal combustion engines to electric vehicles. Several big European battery projects have gone bankrupt, while others have been forced to scale back plans in an industry dominated by Chinese players such as CATL and BYD , the world’s biggest maker of electric cars.
paragraphs.zh: 由于汽车制造商放弃了此前从内燃机转向电动汽车的雄心勃勃的目标，英国和欧洲的电池制造商经历了艰难的几年。几个大型欧洲电池项目已经破产，其他项目则被迫缩减计划。在这个由宁德时代（CATL）和全球最大电动汽车制造商比亚迪（BYD）等中国企业主导的行业中，这一局面尤为突出。

paragraphs.en: JLR’s sister company, Agratas, is building its own gigafactory in Somerset, England. That plant is not scheduled to start production until 2027. The Guardian in June reported that Agratas has faced construction difficulties that could delay the start of production further.
paragraphs.zh: 捷豹路虎的姊妹公司Agratas正在英格兰萨默塞特（Somerset）建造自己的超级工厂。该工厂预计要到2027年才能投产。《卫报》6月曾报道，Agratas面临施工困难，可能进一步推迟投产。

paragraphs.en: JLR, Britain’s largest automotive employer, was close to a supply deal with AESC last year as part of its efforts to secure cells until the Agratas factory is up and running. It is understood JLR has reached agreements with other battery suppliers in the meantime.
paragraphs.zh: 作为在Agratas工厂建成投产前确保电芯供应努力的一部分，英国最大的汽车雇主捷豹路虎去年曾与AESC接近达成供应协议。据了解，捷豹路虎在此期间已与其他电池供应商达成协议。

paragraphs.en: The failure to secure JLR as a customer has had a knock-on impact on AESC. The Sunderland gigafactory has two manufacturing lines operating, but has so far held off installing a third line to supply JLR.
paragraphs.zh: 未能把捷豹路虎争取为客户，对AESC产生了连锁影响。桑德兰超级工厂目前有两条生产线在运行，但迄今尚未安装第三条生产线来为捷豹路虎供货。
